method: Reverse-DCF by bisection: solve the 10-yr FCF growth that sets (PV of 10 yrs + terminal at 2.5%/10% discount + net cash)/shares equal to the last close. Excludes pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names (Oklo, NuScale, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST, Hertz) and banks/insurers.
